paragraphs: Chapter 659
Episode 167. The Fifth Tomb of Temar (3)
The first chapter of the Divine Gear Five had opened.
The tremendous centrifugal and centripetal forces created alongside the shockwave violently vibrated the void, and the already open cracks spewed out spirit energy like blood.
Inside the quivering space that seemed on the verge of collapsing, the two stared at each other for a few seconds.
Jin was the first to close the distance. His body and the sword glowing blue rushed towards Runtia like light.
Crack-!
An earthquake occurred as Sigmund and Charle collided.
In the first offensive and defensive fight after unsheathing the Sword of King's Domination, Jin realized that Runtia had become even stronger than before.
'Mary's Volcano?!'
The family's 7th ultimate technique independently modified by Mary Runkandel. Her Volcano was used as a strengthening technique, not a self-destruction technique like the original.
Jin had never heard that Mary had taught Runtia her Volcano.
'…No, it's different.'
Mary's Volcano places a great burden on the user's body, not completely destroying it.
However, the Volcano Runtia had unfolded was relentlessly tearing her physical body apart.
Like a stone statue breaking, all parts of Runtia's body were splitting and bursting, then instantaneously regenerating.
In other words, Runtia had only changed the form of 'explosion', essentially receiving a similar shock to the original while performing Volcano.
It was possible because of her regenerative power through spirit energy and her naturally transcendent physique.
The emotions Jin felt while facing that astonishing strength were sorrow and regret.
It stemmed from the fact that a blood relative with the potential to become the Sword of the Era had eventually become a monster.
'This is the sword I prepared for you, the youngest one.'
'The chaos-infected ones I've faced so far didn't hesitate to break their bodies.'
Not only those without class, but also most of those with class felt the same. Ron, Smarion, Stal, Lionel, Paddler, and Runtia who he's facing now.
Among them, only Ron High overcame the Devil and rose to the ranks of creation, and what this fact meant was clear.
Only those who are wary of their bodies breaking can move to the next level.
If not, they only become moths jumping into the fire.
'So what?'
'You've become stronger, sister, but that's all.'
'You are already vomiting blood.'
While Runtia's body was constantly breaking and regenerating, she didn't lose her composure.
On the other hand, Jin began to slowly retreat from the moment she started to push in earnest.
The three powers originally possessed by Jin were organically linked, filling in the lacking parts of each attribute.
Among them, especially since the spirit energy was the core of strengthening, it was inevitable that all aspects were lacking more than usual as it was all consumed.
'Of course, you must have some swords still hidden. Show them to me, I want to shiver with excitement.'
Runtia was laughing like a madman with a high-pitched voice.
As the fight became more intense, her excitement grew even more.
'Is her madness covering her pain.'
Unlike Runtia who was rampaging, Jin was gradually reducing his movements.
He judged that Runtia, who had been abnormal from the time Jin arrived, would exhaust her energy more quickly, and that was indeed true.
But Jin was just being more cautious. To seize the opportunity to end the fight in one shot.
'You seem to know everything, sister.'
'Get rid of the trivial talk, this is my last fight.'
His bones were shaking and his whole body was aching. He felt Charle digging deeper into his flesh as Runtia's sword picked up speed.
There were not no gains while he crouched.
'There are occasional gaps in regeneration.'

Naturally, there would be physical constraints in fighting while the body is breaking in real-time. An extremely short interval that would be unnoticeable unless it's a warrior at Jin's level who's incredibly fast.
Jin was analyzing the pattern when that gap occurs.
While it was irregular to the point of being unpredictable, Jin felt that he could impose a rule. By guiding Runtia's attack form in the direction he wanted.
'Although I don't have the senses of the Divine Gear brothers, if Sister Runtia doesn't stop, it's entirely possible.'
Jin's swordplay began to take on a form as soft as water.
Runtia thought that was also a measure Jin chose as a defense.
Of course, even though it was, Runtia didn't make no preparations.
She expected that Jin would naturally have a strategy.
She just couldn't follow Jin's strategy because she was absorbed in her excitement.
And when Charle grazed her neck twice more, Jin was able to face the optimal opportunity to end Runtia.
'Now.'
As Runtia's attack began to skew from the bottom to the top, Jin showed himself leaping into the air as if cornered.
Runtia didn't miss that gap and unfolded consecutive light-speed thrusts, targeting Jin's risen position, the expected landing spot, and a blind spot that Jin could not be aware of.
He can't dodge it.
At that moment, Jin opened the next chapter of the Divine Gear Five that he had been saving.
Divine Sword of the King, the 10th Sword, Form 2
The Sword of King's Domination - 전
The thunderous energy in Jin's eyes emitted an even more intense blue radiance.
Runtia seemed to have been waiting for that very moment as she focused her energy on the tip of Charle's sword.
With the dull black color characteristic of soul energy, a heavy black aura was forming.
Runkandel's 4th Secret Technique
Black Cross
A sword he once saw when he was up against Hedo in the past.
Charle's blade drawn in a cross seemed to have cut Jin in half. Runtia also felt the sensation of her sword cutting through flesh, but it was shallow.
'Even Joshua can be helpful at times.'
In the past, when dealing with Hedo in the White Night's Tower, Jin had once seen the Black Cross unleashed by Joshua.
The secret technique that Runtia unfolded was not comparable to Joshua's, but thanks to his memories of that time, Jin was able to minimize his injuries.
Soon, the sword aura of the Black Cross drew a huge circle around Jin, and the black cross-shaped sword aura pouring from it instantly engulfed Jin's figure.
All of this happened in an instant, including the sword aura of the Black Cross being torn by the aura of the Sword of King's Domination.

The aura of the Sword of King's Domination that Jin unfolded was, of course, beyond Runtia's expectations. For the first time, Runtia began to retreat, but she was mostly hit directly by the aura piercing her flesh.
'Kuhaak...!'
Holes the size of a human head were continuously appearing and disappearing all over Runtia's body.
The speed at which the Sword of King's Domination destroyed her flesh and the speed at which her soul energy regenerated were almost the same.
'The Volcano is still not deactivated. Yet, with this level of regenerative power, indeed, Sister Runtia in this pocket space is almost an immortal being.'
With the impact of the Volcano that Runtia herself unleashed and the second chapter of the Sword of King's Domination.
There are only a few people in the world who can withstand this kind of shock.
Even including those engulfed in chaos.
Runtia wasn't originally included in them, but the reason she was enduring was because this place was 'Runtia's pocket space'.
All the soul energy forming the pocket space was no different from Runtia herself.
She was effectively using all the energy of the space originally created by Soldelet.
In other words, to defeat her, the entire pocket space had to be destroyed. As long as soul energy remained in the pocket space, it was impossible to kill Runtia.
'Kaaaak...!'
Runtia, who was blown far away by the shockwave of the Sword of King's Domination, was floundering like a beast tearing its trap.
She knew.
Just one more reach to Jin, and she can take the youngest's neck.
And also the fact that if Jin had come without his stamina being exhausted, she could never have won.
Jin was controlling the aura of the Sword of King's Domination, sweating profusely.
As much as he had reached a peak, the backflow reaction was not occurring, but he couldn't control the rate at which aura was being consumed.
Just as Runetia said.
If Jin had entered the tomb with his full spirit energy, the circumstances would have been the same, but the outcome would have been different.
If he had retained his full spirit energy, Jin would have been certain to achieve victory in this kind of attritional power struggle against Runetia and her dimensional space.
But not now.
Now the speed of recovery couldn't keep up with the destructive power of the King of Netherworld's Sword, and ultimately, Jin's energy would run out first.
It would be the same even if he started adding magic power now. Unleashing the second level of the King of Netherworld's Sword while adding magic could actually make things even more dangerous.

Inevitably, there will be a gap when casting magic, the precarious balance of power would tilt in Runetia's favor immediately, and since the dimensional space is a 'dead world', it was impossible to summon Tes.

Runetia's strides toward Jin were getting a little bit wider. Even while Runetia's body was twisting, the triple sword she held, Charle, aimed precisely at Jin without moving like a tightly bound ghost.
"Being...tired...and defeated... must...be... frustrating..."
At Runetia's words, Jin closed his eyes once.
However, the deciding factor Jin had in mind was at this very moment.
He had no intention of risking adding magic or releasing aura beyond his limits, expecting a backlash.
The final strategy Jin had saved for dealing with her, who had all the spirit energy of the entire dimensional space, was his spirit energy.
The connection point.
From the beginning of the battle, Jin was confident that there would exist a connection point between Runetia and the dimensional space.
The original owner of the dimensional space is not Runetia.
Runetia only became the owner of the dimensional space forcibly through the trick of the prophet.
Therefore, it was inevitable that she would need a connection point to assimilate with the dimensional space, and Jin had been reading the pattern of how her spirit energy moved throughout the fight.
The reason for unleashing the King of Netherworld's Sword was to precisely confirm the location of the connection point.
'There it is.'
In the midst of the noise, Bradamante quietly slipped out of the scabbard.
Although almost all of the spirit energy was consumed in the task of opening the door, not a single drop was left.
Jin gathered up all the last remaining spirit energy and opened Bradamante.
"No, this is the end, sister."
The King of Netherworld's Sword was deactivated.
Immediately afterwards, Runetia quickly healed all her wounds, and Jin cut off the connection points between Runetia and the dimensional space with his blackened blade.
As soon as the connection points were cut, Runetia could no longer recover, and
Jin took advantage of the moment when Runetia anticipated her recovery and stabbed her in the chest with his sword.
